Purchases and license

Trips and FIRE are premium features. You can try them free for 3 months. After that you can unlock them with a one-time purchase through the App Store or Google Play. There is no subscription and no automatic renewal.

A purchase covers version 1 of Fi.Art, including all 1.x updates. A new major version (2.0) is a separate version: existing customers get a discount on it. If you bought within 4 months before the release of 2.0, you get 2.0 for free.

A purchase belongs to the store where you made it and cannot be transferred to another store or platform. Use "Restore purchases" to get an earlier purchase back on the same account.
